title: Hiring  SAP FICO Finance Consultant
description:
SUMMARY 
 SAP FICO Finance Consultant 
 
 Role Summary 
 We are currently recruiting an experienced SAP FI/CO Consultant with 5 to 8 years of hands-on experience in implementing, configuring, enhancing, and supporting SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions. The successful candidate will exhibit strong functional expertise in core Financial Accounting and Controlling modules, alongside a thorough understanding of system integrations. This professional will be responsible for translating intricate business requirements into streamlined and efficient SAP configurations. 
 
 Location: Singhitarai/Mansa/Nellore 
 
 Experience: 5-10 years 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Direct and manage the full lifecycle of SAP S/4HANA initiatives, ranging from fresh implementations and global expansions to system upgrades and continuous support. 
 Execute configuration and customization tasks for SAP FI/CO modules, encompassing General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), and Bank Accounting (BL) for FI; and Cost Center Accounting (CCA), Internal Orders (IO), Profit Center Accounting (PCA), and Product Costing (PC) for CO. 
 Analyze business needs to design and structure effective financial processes and corresponding SAP solutions. 
 Collaborate closely with finance teams and technical experts to ensure the successful deployment of business requirements. 
 Manage the integration between FI/CO and other SAP functional areas, including Materials Management (MM), Sales and Distribution (SD), Production Planning (PP), and Plant Maintenance (PM). 
 Provide production support by diagnosing issues, performing root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions. 
 Draft functional specifications for reports, interfaces, enhancements, and forms using tools such as IDOCs, BAPIs, and User Exits. 
 Develop test cases, coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and generate comprehensive documentation and training materials for end - users. 
 Supervise project deliverables, assist various workstreams, and offer guidance and mentorship to junior consultants. 
 
 Requirements Hold a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. 
 Demonstrate 5 to 8 years of specialized experience in SAP FI/CO consulting. 
 Have successfully led or participated in at least one end-to-end SAP implementation project. 
 Possess mandatory hands-on proficiency with SAP S/4HANA Finance. 
 Show in-depth knowledge of S/4HANA features, including New General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Parallel Accounting, and Document Splitting. 
 Exhibit advanced configuration capabilities in at least three FI/CO sub - modules. 
 Maintain a solid understanding of accounting standards and core financial business processes. 
 Have practical experience with integration points linking SAP SD, MM, and other logistics modules. 
 Possess a proven track record of creating functional specifications for custom developments, reporting, interfaces, and system enhancements. 
 Display strong analytical skills, problem-solving abilities, effective communication, and stakeholder management capabilities. 
 Preferred Skills 
 Hold a valid SAP S/4HANA Finance certification. 
 Have prior experience working with Central Finance. 
 Demonstrate familiarity with SAP Group Reporting or BPC (Business Planning and Consolidation). 
 Have exposure to SAP Fiori Finance applications. 
 Possess experience within consulting agencies or client-facing roles. 
 Understand Agile and Scrum methodologies.

Key Skills: Consulting,SAP FICO,SAP S Hana,Saps,SAP Hana,FICO,Finance,SAP Finance
